title: LexFlow AI — From documents to an approved handoff

scenes.title:
Keep the evidence.
Move the work forward.
bullets: Receive documents
Review with evidence
Approve and hand off
scenes.detail: A narrated presentation of the v0.11 demonstration guide.
narration: Welcome to Lex Flow A I, a working document workflow prototype.
This presentation follows the version zero point eleven demonstration guide.
We will receive synthetic documents, review their evidence, and approve structured data.
Then we will send that data to a fictional notary workspace.

scenes.title:
Start with a
synthetic workspace.
bullets: Run the local Python or Docker demo.
Sign in with a seeded demonstration account.
Keep the guide and sample files nearby.
narration: Start the local Python launcher or the Docker demonstration.
The default port is eight thousand; the current development demo uses eight thousand and one.
Sign in with a seeded demonstration account.
Use synthetic records throughout, and keep the guide nearby for exact actions.

scenes.title:
Two documents.
One visible conflict.
bullets: Start guided demo creates a fresh matter.
Inspect the questionnaire and register extract.
The land-register values disagree: 812 vs 872.
scenes.detail: Suggestions remain unverified until a reviewer confirms them.
narration: Choose Start guided demo to create a fresh property purchase matter.
Open the buyer questionnaire and the fictional land register extract.
One source names sheet eight hundred and twelve; the other names eight hundred and seventy two.
Lex Flow exposes the disagreement instead of choosing silently.

scenes.title:
Let a person
make the decision.
bullets: Inspect both source suggestions.
Choose Blatt 872 in this fictional scenario.
Confirm required fields, then approve.
scenes.detail: Every unresolved conflict blocks approval, including optional fields.
narration: Inspect both suggestions before making a decision.
In this fictional example, the reviewer chooses sheet eight hundred and seventy two.
Confirm the other required fields and record a note where useful.
Approval stays blocked until required values are valid and every conflict is resolved.

scenes.title:
Approved values.
Clear destination keys.
bullets: Preview the mapped JSON or CSV.
Generate a real downloadable file.
New evidence or changed mappings require approval again.
scenes.detail: A generated file is separate from a destination acceptance receipt.
narration: Open Export approved data and inspect the destination mapping.
Generate a structured JSON file or a spreadsheet friendly CSV file.
The file contains reviewed values linked to the source matter.
Reopening, new evidence, or changed mappings require renewed approval and supersede earlier outputs.

scenes.title:
Preview first.
Send deliberately.
bullets: Select NotaryDesk Demo over HTTPS.
Run a dry run on the approved matter.
Send approved data and inspect the receipt.
scenes.detail: NotaryDesk Demo is fictional; no real notary vendor is connected.
narration: In Integrations, select the approved matter and Notary Desk Demo over H T T P S.
Run a dry run and inspect the mapped payload.
Send the approved data and inspect its accepted receipt.
The request crosses verified local T L S to a separate encrypted case store.

scenes.title:
Continue in
the destination.
bullets: Case details shows received, read-only values.
Move the case to In preparation and save.
Delivery evidence links back to source approval.
scenes.detail: Destination stages have their own revision checks and workspace scope.
narration: Open the demo notary and select the received case.
Case details shows the approved values received from Lex Flow.
Change the preparation stage and save it in the receiving workspace.
Delivery evidence shows the receipt, source approval, and received payload fingerprint.

scenes.title:
Teach the label.
Keep the judgement.
bullets: Preview a literal label for a buyer field.
An administrator saves a versioned rule.
Future matching intake still needs human review.
scenes.detail: Saved rules contain configuration, not the preview example as training data.
narration: Workflow Studio lets an office teach a literal label for a field.
Test the label on a temporary example before saving it.
An administrator saves the rule with version history.
Future matching intake receives a suggestion, while human review remains mandatory.

scenes.title:
Show observations,
not invented savings.
bullets: Record a baseline and actual work sessions.
Keep each destination’s acceptance rate separate.
Use the synthetic benchmark within its stated scope.
scenes.detail: 28 synthetic text cases  ·  Two damaged-label misses  ·  Not an OCR benchmark
narration: Pilot measurement compares an observed baseline with reported work sessions.
Missing observations stay empty, and acceptance rates are separate for each destination.
The synthetic text benchmark records one hundred percent precision and ninety seven point two percent recall.
These results do not establish real office accuracy, O C R quality, or customer savings.

scenes.title:
Protect access.
Preserve decisions.
bullets: Set up an authenticator in My account.
Save recovery codes; each works once.
Inspect audit integrity and active controls.
scenes.detail: MFA is optional in the seeded demo and required in the hardened profile.
narration: In Settings, open My account to set up an authenticator.
Save the recovery codes privately; each can replace a second factor once.
The hardened profile requires enrollment before opening case records.
Security also shows session controls, configured file encryption, and workspace audit verification.

scenes.title:
Prepare for
an interrupted day.
bullets: Transfer intents retain the original key after a crash.
Verify the snapshot before restoring to a new path.
Restored sessions are revoked; evidence and factors survive.
scenes.detail: Inspect uncertain destination outcomes before retrying the same transfer key.
narration: Durable transfer intents retain the original key across an interrupted delivery.
An idempotent receiver prevents a duplicate after it has already accepted the data.
Backups verify their manifest, files, audit history, and encrypted records.
Restore uses a new directory and revokes old sessions while preserving evidence and enrolled factors.

scenes.section: Next / From demonstration to customer pilot
scenes.title:
A complete story.
A clear next step.
bullets: Reviewed case, generated file, signed demo receipt.
Repeatable tests and documented recovery.
Choose a supported vendor and validate an office pilot.
scenes.detail: Allgift Technologies Ltd  ·  LexFlow AI v0.11.0-prototype
narration: The demonstration connects source documents, a human decision, approved output, and a signed fictional handoff.
The release passed one hundred and eleven backend tests and twenty one interface tests.
Browser checks covered one hundred and forty one page and panel views.
Next, select a supported vendor and validate the workflow in an actual customer pilot.
